objective.title: Revalidate and close one selector neighborhood package
objective.statement: Illustrative only: first revalidate whether the historical selector-neighborhood shape remains open at the base commit, then prove one non-vacuous constructor or stop with the exact current blocker.
deliverables: One focused theorem in Poincare/Global/SelectorAssembly.lean or an exact blocked report showing that the historical target is obsolete

stop_conditions: The historical target type no longer matches the current imports
A required change falls outside the allowed file scope
Three proof attempts produce the same elaboration blocker
